def Tparts(fr):
    s=fr.segmentation; bars={};stems={}
    for n in s['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b);r1=max(p[0] for p in b);c0=min(p[1] for p in b);c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        if n['pixels']==3:
            if r0==42 and r1==42: bars[c0]=n['color']
            if r1-r0==2 and c1-c0==0: stems[c0]=n['color']
    return bars,stems
b1,s1=Tparts(current_frame)
print("before: bars",sorted(b1.items()),"stems",sorted(s1.items()))

b2,s2=Tparts(current_frame)
print("after click bar(42,21): bars",sorted(b2.items()),"stems",sorted(s2.items()))
print("board_changed",last_action_result.get('board_changed'),"done",last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
